name: legacy-roundtrip
finding: Four-column headerless CSV and exact source bytes are preserved.

name: no-permanent-record-identity
finding: Output schema marker exists; permanent record ID and statistics version do not.

name: header-shifts-record-number
finding: Adding a header changes the same record number from 1 to 2.

name: reorder-shifts-record-number
finding: Reordering valid rows renumbers the same task.

name: identical-records-retained
finding: Exact duplicate field arrays produce a warning; both records remain.

name: equivalent-minutes-not-flagged
finding: Equivalent values 30/30.0 do not trigger the exact-fields duplicate warning.

name: five-columns-rejected
finding: Schema extension is rejected and the previous valid mirror survives.

name: previous-backup-overwritten
finding: The .previous file rotates; it is not an immutable original archive.

name: valid-source-shortening-accepted
finding: A nonempty valid CSV can remove prior records without a deletion warning.

name: legacy-time-precision-normalized
finding: Minute timestamps become :00 seconds; original text exists only in the raw snapshot.

name: report-version-not-checked-by-builder
finding: BuildMail accepts a changed schema marker when old field names remain; this is a builder probe, not a live dispatch bypass.

name: weekly-summary-has-separate-boundary-policy
finding: Sync weekly is a rolling seven-day window; formal weekly follows Sunday through Saturday.
